newsitem.title: USA: Warrantech sees paying $1.4 mln judgment.
newsitem.headline: Warrantech sees paying $1.4 mln judgment.

text.p: STAMFORD, Conn., June 23 - Warrantech Corp said Monday it expects a judgment of $1.4 million will be awarded against it in litigation brought by The Oak Agency.

The company said the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois issued an oral ruling that a Warrantech subsidiary improperly terminated an agency agreement and was liable for certain payments.
"Warrantech expects a judgment of approximately $1.4 million will be awarded in July," a statement said, although the company added that the court has not yet determined the actual amount.
Oral findings announced by the trial court led Warrantech to anticipate a judgment of $1.4 million, the company said.

Warrantech said the Oak Agency began litigation in October 1991, following the termination of an agency agreement it signed in 1986 with Warrantech Dealer Based Services, a former Warrantech subsidiary now known as Warrantech Automotive Inc.
The Oak Agency had sought more than $23 million in damages, Warrantech said.
Warrantech shares traded at 12 in the early afternoon Monday, up 5/8.
